dataset.citation: 5G-QoERA drive-test export (Boffetti et al., IEEE WCNC 2025; telematics-lab/5G-QoERA, GPL-3.0), converted to CSV with throughput and per-bitrate MOS columns; task shape follows decision-tree QoE prediction from network measurements.
dataset.label: poor QoE when MOS <= 2

bs_crossstation_poor_tree.model: hi = bitrateKbps > rootBitrateThreshold; predictedPoor = hi ? (tput < highTputThreshold) : (tput < lowTputThreshold)
bs_crossstation_poor_tree.literatureTask: Decision-tree QoE/acceptability classification from network measurements; implemented as verifiable encrypted inference of an off-chain-fitted quantized tree, not private training.
